support_faq1_q: How are my files turned into summaries and quizzes?
support_faq1_a: When you add a source, it’s processed into a knowledge base scoped to that workspace. Chat answers and generated summaries, flashcards, and quizzes are grounded only in your own materials.
support_faq2_a: Workspaces are private by default. You can switch one to public or share it with a link from the workspace’s edit menu. Nothing is shared until you choose to.
support_faq3_q: Can I import from Google Drive or OneDrive?
support_faq3_a: Yes — open a workspace, choose Add source, and pick a drive. Drive import activates once the backend connection is set up; uploading from your computer works today.
support_faq4_q: What kinds of quiz questions can I generate?
support_faq4_a: Multiple choice, multi-select, true/false, fill-in-the-blank, short answer, matching, and ordering — across easy, medium, and hard difficulty. Pick the mix when you generate.
support_faq5_q: How does the login streak work?
support_faq5_a: Open Capy Notebook on consecutive days to grow your streak, shown at the top of the dashboard. Miss a day and it resets — no penalty beyond starting again.

question_validation_awarded_marks: Authored questions cannot contain awarded marks.
question_validation_awarded_range: Awarded marks exceed the marking scheme or are not half marks.
question_validation_bank_solution: Bank questions need a worked solution for every part.
question_validation_asset_host: Figures must use the configured bank asset host.
question_validation_upload_graphs: Upload bank graphs before saving the question.
question_validation_quiz_part_ids: Part IDs must be unique throughout the quiz.
question_computation_warning_title: This open answer may be graded wrongly
question_computation_warning_body: Grading it needs a calculation, expression or unit conversion checked, which open-answer grading cannot do reliably. Use a short answer with a fixed unit or a choice question instead.
question_validation_quiz_question_parts: A question has at most {max} parts.
question_validation_gap_markers: Write each gap in the text as (1) ______, (2) ______ and so on, one per accepted list.
question_validation_markscheme_open: Open answers need a marking scheme, and only open answers have one.
question_validation_markscheme_total: The marking items must add up to the part's marks.
question_validation_quiz_markscheme: A part has at most {max} marking items.
question_validation_open_answer_length: Sample answers are limited to {max} characters.
question_validation_quiz_parts: A quiz has at most {max} parts.
question_validation_quiz_open_parts: A quiz has at most {max} open-answer parts.
chat_library_hint: Also search the shared textbook library for this message.
chat_grounded_library: Answers grounded in your sources and the textbook library
study_prefs_hint: How the chat builds notes and practice for you. A request can always ask for something else.
study_pref_main_hint: What explains each chapter. Automatic picks a deck for brief explainers and a note for detailed ones.
study_pref_practice_hint: What the chat builds to practise a chapter.
study_pref_cards_hint: Cards in a chapter's flashcard set.
study_pref_checks_hint: A few questions or cards at the end of each note section.
study_pref_visuals_hint: How often notes add diagrams, mindmaps and interactive blocks.
review_grade_failed: Couldn't check this answer. Try again.
review_load_failed: Couldn't load the next review items.
review_no_workspaces: Attempt a quiz or study flashcards in a workspace to review them here.
study_nothing_yet: Read a file or attempt a quiz to start tracking your progress.
study_off: Progress is off in this workspace. Quiz results are still kept.
study_progress_default_hint: Keep what you read and practise in new workspaces. Each workspace can turn it off.
study_reset_confirm_body: Clears what you have read and practised in this workspace. Quiz results stay.
study_reset_hint: Clears what you have read and practised here. Quiz results stay.
